brand_identity.target_audience: Medical officers in rural clinics (Malaysia) - field usage on tablets/desktop.

rules: Headings (Work Sans): tracking-tight for sizes above 24px.
Body (IBM Plex Sans): leading-relaxed for clinical reports.
Do NOT use Inter or generic sans.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6) between widgets, generous internal padding (p-6) in cards.
layout_and_spacing.borders_and_radius: Flat solid surfaces, subtle 1px border (border-border), rounded-md (6px) or rounded-lg (8px) max. No glassmorphism.

components.cards: Flat background, 1px border. Hover state adds shadow-sm. No default heavy shadows to maintain a clean clinical look.
components.buttons: Primary button uses #0F7650. MUST define hover state text color (hover:text-white).
components.forms: Use Shadcn Form, Input, Select. Labels left-aligned. Input fields strictly rectangular with soft corners.
components.badges: Severity badges must use respective severity colors for background (at 10-20% opacity) and 100% opacity text for contrast (e.g., bg-red-100 text-red-700).
components.xray_viewer: Interactive multi-modal canvas. Bounding box annotations overlaying image. Support drag/drop and camera capture. Bounding boxes must use high-contrast stroke.
components.charts: Recharts radar/bar chart for pathology scores. Minimalist styling, strict grid lines, clear tooltips.

motion.rules: Minimalist. Shimmer loaders for AI processing (vital for clinical trust). No bouncy or playful animations. Use standard 0.2s ease transitions for hover states.

new_screening.layout: 2-column split (desktop) or stack (mobile). Left: Patient intake form. Right: Drag-and-drop X-ray upload area / Camera capture.
new_screening.behavior: Post-upload, right side shifts to X-ray viewer and AI analysis results.

history_dashboard.layout: Data-dense list or table. Rows must include: thumbnail, patient category, age, gender, date, and severity badge.
history_dashboard.behavior: Clicking a row navigates to Screening Detail.

screening_detail.layout: Bento grid (Control Room mode). Left large column: Annotated X-ray Viewer. Right column: AI results, pathology breakdown chart, and EN/BM report tab toggle. Top right: Delete record action.

login_background.description: Person sitting while using laptop computer and green stethoscope near (subtle medical background, if needed for auth).

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure text over colored severity badges meets WCAG AA standards.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='upload-xray', data-testid='severity-badge').

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the UI using React (.js and .jsx files, NOT TypeScript), Tailwind CSS, and shadcn/ui components.
Use Recharts for the pathology breakdown visualization.
Ensure fully responsive behavior (usable on rural clinic tablets).
Maintain strict clinical tone: No playful animations, zero glassmorphism, flat data surfaces.
Implement EN/BM toggle functionality for the clinical report.
Ensure the X-ray viewer can display bounding box data over the image.
